//: T-TEST-10 mutation testing. SCOPED to fast, security-critical PURE modules whose fast node selftests fully cover them. Runs via the built-in `command` test-runner (we do not use jest/mocha) — the command chains the exact covering selftests and exits nonzero if any regression survives. See docs/MUTATION-TESTING.md. NOT part of default CI: it is slow and periodic.
//commandRunner: Chain of ONLY the fast selftests that cover the scoped files. gateway.mjs -> egress-policy + replay-cache; gateway-registry.mjs -> gateway-registry; directory.mjs -> directory + directory-rotation; announce.mjs -> bootnode/selftest (exercises buildAnnounce/verifyAnnounce via makeServer). Any failing selftest short-circuits (&&) => mutant KILLED. Deliberately excludes the slow real-Groth16 suites (rln, rln-slash, timing).

commandRunner.command: node packages/node/gateway/egress-policy.selftest.mjs && node packages/node/gateway/replay-cache.selftest.mjs && node packages/node/lib/gateway-registry.selftest.mjs && node packages/node/lib/directory.selftest.mjs && node packages/node/lib/directory-rotation.selftest.mjs && node packages/node/bootnode/selftest.mjs

//mutate: High-value pure files with thorough fast tests. packages/node/lib/rln.mjs is intentionally EXCLUDED — mutating it forces the slow real-proof suite. Narrow the set on the CLI for a quick smoke run, e.g. `npx stryker run --mutate packages/node/lib/gateway-registry.mjs`.
//coverageAnalysis: The command runner cannot map mutants to individual tests, so run the full selftest chain for every mutant.
//perf: Low concurrency to stay friendly on a laptop; timeout tuned for the ~2s selftest chain plus overhead.
//thresholds: high = solid, low = investigate survivors, break unset (never fails a build; this is a diagnostic, not a gate).
